title: The Book of Enoch
subtitle: How an Ancient Jewish Library Survived Outside the Western Bible
description: Fragments of Enoch turned up at Qumran, but the only complete surviving collection came through Ethiopia. Following the manuscripts shows how the work moved through Jewish and Christian history—and why the familiar claim that it was simply removed from the Bible does not fit the evidence.
author: EmberFire Research
tagline: When systems fail, we build our own.
subtagline: Investigating the gaps between the official record and the full story.
